 We've reached the final of the WTA event in Osaka, where during the early hours of Sunday morning, at least for US viewers, Ashlyn Krueger will be searching for a second WTA title. To achieve that, the American will need to get the better of the more experienced Katerina Siniakova, who is searching for a sixth WTA title. 
 We cannot underestimate Ashlyn Krueger's recent form, but she does not have a promising record against Katerina Siniakova, and that's not easy to ignore, so much so that the Czech player is well worth betting on to come out on top. Given her fine record against this opponent, Siniakova should be priced a little less leniently, especially after winning each of her last three matches in straight sets.

 Our Ashlyn Krueger vs Katerina Siniakova Prediction
 Given that this is a final between two non-top-50 players, anything could easily happen, but the fact that Katerina Siniakova has won four out of four previous matches against Ashlyn Krueger really is difficult to overlook. The Czech player knows exactly what to do to get the better of this opponent, and on that basis, her early odds of -137 look quite generous.
 If we consider also the hot form that she's shown in Osaka, then it's wouldn't be unfair to say that she warrants support closer to -175.
